title: 第一卷 第25章 今晚不必怜惜我第一卷 第26章 晨雾别红衣残城遍尸骨
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
李寒山心一沉。
他抬头看向吴天雄，发现对方正对着他冷笑，眼中满是得意，那表情仿佛在说：老东西，这次你插翅难逃。
这家伙的表情，让李寒山隐隐觉得，这次任务，吴天雄多半做了什么手脚。
花弄影握紧了手中的烟杆，脸色铁青，正要开口说什么，鲁执事的声音再次响起。
“此次任务非同小可，阴冥宗余孽手段诡异，单靠炼气期弟子恐难应付。”鲁执事目光扫过众人，“因此，还需要两名筑基弟子带队。”
花弄影犹豫片刻，咬了咬唇，上前一步：“鲁执事，我去吧。”
鲁执事摇头：“不必了，上面已有人选。”
花弄影一愣。
鲁执事继续道：“此次带队的核心弟子，是吴天雄与柳若雪。”
吴天雄？
柳若雪？
花弄影脸色剧变，李寒山也是心道不妙——吴天雄带队，柳若雪副队，这两人一个是他的死对头，另一个是花弄影的死对头，这组合简直是要他的命。
不过，这任务吴天雄居然也要去，是不是说明任务本身的危险程度没那么大？
吴天雄哈哈大笑，大步上前，朝鲁执事抱拳道：“多谢鲁执事信任，弟子定不负宗门所托！”
他说着，转头看向李寒山，眼中满是得意与杀意。
柳若雪则站在人群边缘，听到自己的名字，她脸上没有丝毫表情，仿佛这件事与她无关。只是目光不经意间扫过花弄影时，眼中寒意更浓了几分。
鲁执事挥了挥手：“都回去准备吧，明日一早出发。”
说完，他便转身走回了外务殿，大门轰然关闭。
人群渐渐散去。

吴天雄走到李寒山面前，冷笑道：“老东西，这次你死定了。出了合欢宗，我看还有谁能护着你。”
花弄影冷冷道：“吴天雄，你别太过分。他若出了什么事，我第一个饶不了你。”
“饶不了我？”
吴天雄仿佛听到了什么笑话：“花弄影，你以为我会怕你？我爹现在是金丹长老，你一个刚突破筑基的核心弟子，拿什么饶不了我？”
花弄影冷哼一声。
吴天雄不转向李寒山：“老东西，好好享受今晚吧。明天开始，你的好日子就到头了。”
说完，他大笑着离去。
花弄影咬着唇，死死盯着吴天雄离去的背影，李寒山拉了拉她的手：“走吧，回去再说。”
两人祭出飞剑，返回了主峰洞府。
一进洞府，花弄影便像热锅上的蚂蚁一般来回踱步，脸上满是焦急。
“吴天雄那畜生肯定会在路上动手，柳若雪那贱人巴不得看我的笑话，绝不会出手相助......”
她越说越急，眼眶都红了起来。
李寒山在石榻边坐下，平静地看着她，道：“我死了，你就自由了，不正合你意吗？”
花弄影的身体一僵。
片刻后，她走到李寒山面前，蹲下身，仰头看着他。那张平日里妖娆妩媚的脸上，此刻竟带着几分少见的认真。
“主人想听真话还是假话？”
李寒山看着她那双勾人的眼眸，道：“真话。”
花弄影深吸一口气，一字一顿道：“我当然想主人死。主人死了，奴家就自由了，再也不用受制于人，也不用担心哪天主人一个念头就要了奴家的命。”
她顿了顿，接着道：“但主人的功法经天纬地，奴家还没有得到，怎么舍得主人死？”
李寒山嘴角抽了抽。

得，这话够实在。
花弄影继续道：“再说了，主人若是在死前断了奴家的生机，那奴家岂不是给主人陪葬了？这笔买卖，怎么算都不划算。”
李寒山沉默片刻：“怪不得人们都喜欢听假话，因为真话确实挺扎心的。”
花弄影扑哧一声笑了出来，她起身带球撞人，双臂环上他的脖子，声音又娇又软：“刚刚人家是故意那样说的啦～寒郎可是人家的至爱，人家哪里舍得寒郎死~”
content_en:
;;
Li Hanshan's heart sank.
He looked up at Wu Tianxiong and found that the other person was sneering at him, his eyes full of pride, and his expression seemed to say: Old man, you can't escape this time.
This guy's expression made Li Hanshan vaguely feel that Wu Tianxiong might have done something wrong during this mission.
Hua Nongying clenched the cigarette rod in her hand, her face turned livid, and just as she was about to say something, Deacon Lu's voice sounded again.
"This mission is no small matter. The remnants of the Yin Ming Sect are using strange methods, and it may be difficult for Qi Refining Stage disciples alone to handle it." Deacon Lu glanced at everyone, "Therefore, two more Foundation Establishment disciples are needed to lead the team."
Hua Nongying hesitated for a moment, bit her lip, and took a step forward: "Deacon Lu, I'll go."
Deacon Lu shook his head: "No need, there is already a candidate from above."
Hua Nongying was stunned.
Deacon Lu continued: "The core disciples leading the team this time are Wu Tianxiong and Liu Ruoxue."
Wu Tianxiong?
Liu Ruoxue?
Hua Nongying's face changed drastically, and Li Hanshan also had something bad in his mind - Wu Tianxiong led the team, and Liu Ruoxue was his deputy. One of these two people was his mortal enemy, and the other was Hua Nongying's mortal enemy. This combination was simply going to kill him.
However, Wu Tianxiong actually wants to go on this mission. Does this mean that the mission itself is not that dangerous?
Wu Tianxiong laughed loudly, strode forward, clasped his fists towards Deacon Lu and said, "Thank you so much, Deacon Lu, for your trust. I will definitely live up to the trust of the sect!"
As he spoke, he turned to look at Li Hanshan, his eyes full of pride and murderous intent.
Liu Ruoxue stood on the edge of the crowd. When she heard her name, her face showed no expression at all, as if the matter had nothing to do with her. But when his eyes glanced at Hua Nongying inadvertently, the coldness in his eyes became a little stronger.
Deacon Lu waved his hand: "Go back and prepare. We will set off early tomorrow morning."
After saying that, he turned around and walked back to the Foreign Affairs Hall, and the door slammed shut.
The crowd gradually dispersed.
Wu Tianxiong walked up to Li Hanshan and sneered: "Old guy, you're dead this time. Once you get out of the Hehuan Sect, I'll see who else can protect you."
Hua Nongying said coldly: "Wu Tianxiong, don't go too far. If anything happens to him, I will be the first to spare you."
"Can't you spare me?"
Wu Tianxiong seemed to have heard some joke: "Hua Nongying, do you think I will be afraid of you? My father is now the elder of Jindan. You, a core disciple who has just broken through Foundation Establishment, why can't you spare me?"
Hua Nongying snorted coldly.
Wu Tianxiong turned to Li Hanshan and said, "Old guy, enjoy tonight. Starting tomorrow, your good days will come to an end."
After saying that, he laughed and left.
Hua Nongying bit her lip and stared at Wu Tianxiong's leaving figure. Li Hanshan pulled her hand: "Let's go, let's talk about it when we get back."
The two of them used their flying swords and returned to the main peak cave.
As soon as she entered the cave, Hua Nongying paced back and forth like an ant on a hot pot, her face full of anxiety.
"That beast Wu Tianxiong will definitely take action on the road. That bitch Liu Ruoxue is eager to see my joke and will never help..."
The more she spoke, the more anxious she became, and her eyes became red.
Li Hanshan sat down by the stone couch, looked at her calmly, and said, "If I die, you will be free. Isn't that what you want?"
Hua Nongying's body stiffened.
After a moment, she walked up to Li Hanshan, squatted down, and looked up at him. That face that was usually enchanting and charming now actually had a rare seriousness to it.
"Master, do you want to hear the truth or lies?"
Li Hanshan looked at her seductive eyes and said, "The truth."
Hua Nongying took a deep breath and said word by word: "Of course I want the master to die. When the master dies, the slave family will be free. They no longer have to be controlled by others, and there is no need to worry that one day the master will kill the slave family at a thought."
She paused and then continued: "But the master's skills are world-famous and the slave family has not yet obtained them. How can I be willing to let the master die?"
Li Hanshan's mouth twitched.
Yes, this is true enough.
Hua Nongying continued:"Besides, if the master cuts off the life of the slave family before his death, wouldn't the slave family be buried with the master? This deal is not worthwhile no matter how you calculate it."
Li Hanshan was silent for a moment: "No wonder people like to listen to lies, because the truth is really heartbreaking."
Hua Nongying burst out laughing. She stood up and hit him with the ball. She put her arms around his neck and said in a delicate and soft voice: "I just said that on purpose~ Han Lang is my most beloved, how can I be willing to let Han Lang die~"
